ValidationRule.description: If the picklist value "Other" is selected for the field "Lead Source" on the TTS Opportunity page, the "Other Lead Source" field is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( RecordType.Name ='TTS OTCRM Opportunity', ISBLANK( Other_Lead_Source__c ), ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , 'Other') ), AND( RecordType.Name ='TTS OTCRM Opportunity', NOT(ISBLANK( Other_Lead_Source__c )), NOT(ISPICKVAL( LeadSource , 'Other')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill out "Other Lead Source" only if "Other" was chosen as the Lead Source field. If you did not choose "Other", leave it blank
